name: OptiGD
description: Experimental performance-measurement and tuning mod for Geometry Dash 2.2081. Most optimizations are off by default; see the changelog for what is connected in this beta.

tier-preset.name: Performance Profile
tier-preset.description: Effective tuning profile. LowEnd is the most aggressive; HighEnd the least; Custom uses the values from the tuning settings. The adaptive governor may move between presets when enabled.

enable-culling.name: Spatial Culling Measurement
enable-culling.description: Measures how many objects a spatial index would cull. Does not hide or skip any object in v0.1.0-beta.1.

enable-particle-limits.name: Particle Throttling (not connected)
enable-particle-limits.description: Reserved. Not connected to particle systems in v0.1.0-beta.1; has no gameplay effect.

enable-adaptive.name: Adaptive Governor
enable-adaptive.description: Chooses the effective profile from measured frame intervals. Changes only OptiGD's own effective tuning; never edits your settings.

show-diagnostics.name: Diagnostics Label
show-diagnostics.description: Shows frame-interval statistics and shadow-culling counts in the log and the diagnostics summary.

record-frametimes.name: Record Frame Times (CSV)
record-frametimes.description: Writes per-frame timings to a CSV file in the mod save directory for offline analysis. Off by default.

custom-particle-density.name: Custom: Particle Density
custom-particle-density.description: Used only with the Custom profile. Scale for cosmetic particle emission (0.05 to 1.0).

custom-max-particles.name: Custom: Max Active Particles
custom-max-particles.description: Used only with the Custom profile. Global particle budget (128 to 16384).

custom-padding-x.name: Custom: Camera Padding X
custom-padding-x.description: Used only with the Custom profile. Horizontal padding in pixels added to the camera rectangle (0 to 600).

custom-padding-y.name: Custom: Camera Padding Y
custom-padding-y.description: Used only with the Custom profile. Vertical padding in pixels added to the camera rectangle (0 to 600).
